JSW Steel Reports 3% Production Increase in August

JSW Steel's crude steel production in August increased by 3% year-on-year, reaching 24.65 lakh tonnes. This growth occurred despite a reported 11% decline in production at its US operations, which amounted to 0.78 lakh tonnes. The company attributed the overall rise primarily to increased domestic production.
